audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 2 were given to Tahm Kench while whys[1] and whys[2] call levels 2-3 'your cleanest kill window of the lane'; row 0 was 'Skill' while whys[0] says he eats your poke for free; row 4 was 'Skill' while whys[4] and spikes[1] describe level 6 as Kled's window.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1 against an 11s Bear Trap, so Kled's 2-3 and level-6 commits land in windows Tahm Kench cannot answer twice; level 1 belongs to the champion who regenerates chip damage for free.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 -> Tahm Kench (4/10), 1 and 2 -> Kled (7/10), 4 -> Kled (6/10), as paired full+content rows. Row 3 left as Kled to match the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as 'your R interrupts his W devour wind-up' and late game as 'his R global roams'.
audit.why: Devour is his R and Abyssal Dive is his W — the two were swapped throughout. Devour eats a single champion for a few seconds (damaging an enemy, shielding an ally); nothing in Riot's text makes it a roaming tool, so 'global R roams' was invented. Whether Kled's R can interrupt the Abyssal Dive wind-up is not stated anywhere, so I replaced that claim with the cooldown fact that actually makes the window real: 21s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected in whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1], spikes[3], mid, late and both wants lists; the interrupt claim replaced with the Dive cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stack mechanic — the thing that decides every trade — was reduced to 'dodge his Q tongue'.
audit.why: An Acquired Taste builds a stack every time he damages you, and Tongue Lash applies one too. At THREE stacks he can either stun you with Tongue Lash or Devour you outright, and the stacks are consumed. So the tell is the stack count on your bar, not the tongue itself. Thick Skin (E, 3s) stores a percent of everything you deal and either heals it back out of combat or converts it to a shield on cast — that is the 'grey health' the text referred to without ever naming.
audit.corrected: Stack rule added to early, mid, dosFull[2], dontsFull[1], report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns; Thick Skin named where grey health is discussed. Matches the mirror's wording.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] said Tahm Kench heals back faster than Kled can re-apply, but the row it labels is set to Kled in both layers.
audit.why: The two layers agreed on 'Kled' but the why-string argued the opposite, so the page contradicted itself. The mirror settled levels 4-5 as Kled's, so the why is what needed rewriting.
audit.corrected: whys[3] rewritten around the 21s Abyssal Dive window that makes 4-5 Kled's.

edits.before: Tahm Kench wants to eat your level-1 poke on grey health and regen it for free, so don't waste mount HP trading into nothing — wait for your spikes. Your real window is levels 2-3: W (Violent Tendencies) on-hit shots plus the full E-in, W-pull, Q-yank, re-E burst can drop him before that grey-health passive ticks back. Dodge his Q tongue — if it stuns you while dismounted off Skaarl, he flips the whole trade and can W-devour you. Land your Q (Bear Trap) first so the slow keeps him in your shotgun range.
edits.after: Tahm Kench wants to eat your level-1 poke on Thick Skin's grey health and regen it for free, so don't spend mount HP on nothing — wait for your spikes. Your real window is levels 2-3: Violent Tendencies plus the full E-in, Bear Trap yank, re-E burst can drop him before that grey health ticks back. Watch the stacks, not the tongue — every hit he lands builds An Acquired Taste, and at three he can stun you with Tongue Lash or Devour you outright.

edits.before: This is where he starts winning the attrition. By 4-5 his grey-health passive plus early tank components heal back everything your percent-HP Q chews off, so single trades stop converting. At 6 you get a real window back: your R knock-back interrupts his W devour wind-up and the charge-in lets you all-in before he stacks resists — that is the stage you fight for. But respect his 6 too: his R is a global roam, so if you over-commit and he is missing, expect a flank.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours if you count cooldowns. Abyssal Dive is 21s at rank 1 against your 11-second Bear Trap — two of your traps to one of his dives, so never open into a fresh Dive; make him spend it, then commit the re-E. At 6 you keep the edge: ram him with R while the Dive is down and he has no reposition. What you cannot do is stand there feeding An Acquired Taste stacks — at three he stuns or Devours you.

edits.before: You fall off and he takes over. Tahm Kench's grey health, W devour, and percent-HP profile mean he simply out-lasts your frontloaded Eclipse/Trinity burst once he has Heartsteel-tier items, and his R turns him into a global teamfight pick threat while your combo does flat damage to a drain tank. Your only path is the lead you built at 2-3 and 6 — sidelane-pressure with R roams and end before his sustain itemization fully comes online. If it goes 25+ minutes even, he wins the lane war.
edits.after: You fall off and he takes over. Thick Skin banks a share of everything you land and heals it back out of combat, so once he has Heartsteel-tier items your frontloaded Eclipse burst stops sticking, and Devour removes one of your carries from a fight for several seconds. Your only path is the lead you built at 2-3 and 6 — sidelane pressure with R roams, and end before his sustain itemization is fully online. If it goes 25+ minutes even, he wins the attrition.
